study_type: EXPLORATORY (algorithm development; the 20 AF2 datasets were already analysed in AF2-AF4, so freezing this protocol does not make AF5 an independent confirmatory test)
lineage: E-consistent per-column + PR #129 generic model (experimental prototype; not adoptable). PR #129 not merged; AF1/AF2 Draft PRs; AF3/AF4 unpushed

objective.primary: S_j(m;a) = max_f [Phi_m(Z_hat_m(f), f) + (nK/2) log 2π − ½ log|H_m(f)|]; the Laplace-corrected objective is what is maximised over f_j
objective.secondary_variant: joint-MAP: f_j maximises Phi_m(Z_hat(f), f) (envelope gradient), Laplace term added afterwards; recorded only
objective.fixed: theta_{-j} (other loadings, Gaussian variances, w0, w, var_z) and families of other columns, from the anchor's saved AF2 refit state; identical for both candidates
objective.free: family m of column j, loading f_j, Z (joint mode re-solved per candidate and per f_j)
objective.phi: AF4 log_joint_parts (independent; base measures included: Poisson −log x!, CMP2 −2 log x!)
objective.hessian: full nK×nK with Y cross blocks (laplace_k_criterion.negative_hessian)
objective.not: not Bayesian evidence (theta not integrated), not BIC, not a Q value; equal parameter counts

anchors.auto_first: PRIMARY (AF2 Auto refit, Poisson start; usable without the truth)
anchors.oracle: DIAGNOSTIC only, never in the primary improvement

unit_of_decision: each count column independently; other columns keep the anchor's families; no sequential update

optimisation.inner: find_joint_mode (damped full Newton) aiming at 1e-11 (max_iter 50), then up to 5 pure Newton polish steps; accepted when max|grad| <= 1e-08; warm start from the previous accepted mode, first start = anchor Zmode
optimisation.change_log: Phase 0 attempt 1 (kept in phase0_attempt1/) required 1e-10 and failed the gate on floating-point stalls; changed before any Δ was computed
optimisation.outer: BFGS on −S with central finite-difference gradient (step 0.0001), gtol 1e-05, maxiter 200
optimisation.starts: anchor's own loading for column j; candidate-specific plug-in (Q-type optimum on anchor Zmode, L=1)

decision_status.FAILED: computation failed for a candidate (recorded, not retried)
decision_status.UNDECIDED_NOT_CONVERGED: either candidate: |FD grad S|_inf > 0.001 at the optimum, or S recomputed from the anchor Zmode differs by > 1e-06
decision_status.UNDECIDED_NUMERIC: |Δ| <= max(0.01, start disagreement of either candidate)
decision_status.UNDECIDED_LAPLACE: IS readable (relative ESS >= 0.01 for both) and (sign(Δ + Δc) != sign(Δ) or |Δ| < 2 SE_batch(Δc)); Δc from common-random-number IS
decision_status.DECIDED_LAPLACE_UNASSESSED: IS not readable; decided by the sign of Δ, flagged

importance_sampling.proposal: N(Z_hat_m, H_m^-1) per candidate with COMMON eps
importance_sampling.caution: with low ESS the correction is not a high-precision truth

data.masks: AF2 / M1 build_masks(r): Y train mask of the regime; test pairs never used

primary_metrics: Auto anchor: column accuracy by sign of Δ (all non-FAILED, non-UNDECIDED_NOT_CONVERGED/NUMERIC columns), by true family and regime; and 'confident' accuracy among DECIDED
corrections: AF2 Auto (Poisson start) misselected columns that the Auto-anchor Laplace gets right
harms: AF2 Auto correct columns that the Auto-anchor Laplace gets wrong
dataset-level change in the number of correct count columns (Laplace − AF2 Auto), bootstrap CI
secondary_metrics: paired with the Q-score on the SAME anchor (AF3: Z7 Auto refit, Z5 Support-only, Z3 Oracle samples, zero start)
statistical_unit: dataset (20 per regime); columns within a dataset are not independent

pilot.purpose: feasibility, time, memory, reproducibility, numerical error; settings are NOT tuned on pilot accuracy; the pilot replicates are recomputed in the full run with the same settings
pilot.stop_rule: stop before Phase 2 if > 10% of pilot columns are FAILED or UNDECIDED_NOT_CONVERGED, or the Phase 0 gate fails

not_claimed: Z recovery after re-fitting (no MCEM refit of a corrected assignment); a confirmed algorithm (a new-seed confirmation study is required)
